definitions.gloss: rice washing; rinsing rice before cooking
definitions.explanation: The process of washing uncooked rice with water to remove starch, bran, and impurities before cooking. An essential step in preparing Japanese rice.

examples.japanese: {米研|こめと}ぎは{毎日|まいにち}の{仕事|しごと}だ。
examples.english: Washing rice is a daily task.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもに{米研|こめと}ぎを{手伝|てつだ}ってもらった。
examples.english: I had the children help with washing the rice.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{無洗米|むせんまい}があるので、{米研|こめと}ぎをしなくてもいい。
examples.english: These days there is no-wash rice, so you don't have to wash the rice.

notes: Compound of {米|こめ} (uncooked rice) + {研|と}ぎ (polishing/washing, from {研|と}ぐ). The traditional method involves swirling rice in water and draining it several times until the water runs clear. The water left from washing rice ({研|と}ぎ{汁|じる}) has traditionally been reused for watering plants or as a cooking stock. {無洗米|むせんまい} (pre-washed/no-rinse rice) has become popular as a time-saving alternative.
